hooks.command:
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  file_path="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH}"
  npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>&1
  exit_code=$?
  if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
    echo '{"feedback": "Formatting failed. Check file for syntax errors."}' >&2
    exit 1
  else
    echo '{"feedback": "Formatting applied.", "suppressOutput": true}'
  fi
fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ package\.json$ ]]; then
  echo '{"feedback": "Installing dependencies..."}' >&2
  yarn install >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"feedback": "Dependencies installed.", "suppressOutput": true}' || {
    echo '{"feedback": "Failed to install dependencies."}' >&2
    exit 1
  }
fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.spec\.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  file_path="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH}"
  echo '{"feedback": "Running related tests..."}' >&2
  if [[ "$file_path" =~ apps/api ]]; then
    yarn workspace api test --findRelatedTests "$file_path" --passWithNoTests 2>&1 | tail -20
  elif [[ "$file_path" =~ apps/web ]]; then
    yarn workspace web test --findRelatedTests "$file_path" --passWithNoTests 2>&1 | tail -20
  fi
  exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
    echo '{"feedback": "Tests passed."}'
  else
    echo '{"feedback": "Tests failed. See output above."}' >&2
  fi
fi
